name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-01-05, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.23 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
